title: Scheduled reports
subtitle: Receive Mastodon analytics automatically for selected accounts. Completed reports are saved here.
name: Schedule name
accountsHelp: Enter each @user@server or profile link on a new line. A username without a server refers to the configured Mastodon server. A separate report is created for each account.
accountsOnePerLine: Enter each account on a new line, without spaces.
invalidAccounts: Use a username, @user@server, or a profile link such as https://server/@user.
periodHelp: Reports cover the completed days before the scheduled date. Monthly reports are generated on the first of the month for the entire previous calendar month.
quotaHelp: Each new report for one account uses one credit from your plan's daily Mastodon analytics limit. Viewing saved reports does not use credits.
websiteHelp: Reports remain available on the website whether Telegram delivery is enabled or not.
botHelp: Link your Telegram bot account and enable automatic file delivery in bot settings to receive reports.
botExportsHelp: Enable automatic file delivery in bot settings. Until then, reports are saved on the website.
created: Schedule created. Reports will appear after the first run.
queued: Report generation queued. The results will appear in history.
error: Unable to load or update reports. Please try again.
limitReached: The schedule limit has been reached. Delete a schedule to add another.
emptySchedules: Create a schedule to collect analytics automatically.
confirmDelete: Delete this schedule? Automatic generation will stop. Saved reports will remain available.
emptyHistory: No reports yet. Wait for the scheduled run or select Generate now.
reportFailed: This report could not be generated. Check the account availability and generate it again.
dataHelp: Reports cover original public and unlisted account posts published during the selected period and available to the configured Mastodon server. Boosts are excluded. Favourites, boosts, and replies are the cumulative counts known to that server when the report is generated.
